authority: #K2-376 sec.4.3: the authorised A-prime run (N=1) FAILED => STOP and return to this PLANNING layer. This artifact is the required regression deliverable (sec.16.3 four elements).
element_1_cause_of_death: the authorised run used the RIGHT method (COPY the in-repo product C17 v1) and it improved every burden metric by a large factor (C1 40->14, C2 564->249, geometry class delta 362->47), but A-prime still FAILS on C6: the product ADDS new copper OUTSIDE the frozen frame (241 pieces added, 9 removed, measured), because its re-route phase works on the AFFECTED NETS' full extent rather than inside the block. So C1->0 and C6=0 are in tension under a straight copy: the product has no notion of 'block'.

element_2_proven_facts.fact: the product path beats the parallel block re-lay on every burden metric
C6 fails because the RE-ROUTE (not the rip) leaves the frame

reading.note: C17 v1 clips the rip at its damage zone (its own docstring), so the C6 delta is dominated by NEW copper laid by the stitch/repair phases outside the frame - i.e. a ROUTER-SCOPE property, not a rip-scope one

element_2_proven_facts.fact: the product's own acceptance also failed

reading.line: routing diff != 0, ZERO NEW violations vs baseline, skew 8/8 <= 0.15, unconnected == 0

element_2_proven_facts.note: so the residual C1=14 is NOT a judging artefact of ours - the product itself cannot close it with its current parameters

reading.incident: a first invocation fell through to the legacy composer because of a guard bug in the new branch; it was detected and KILLED with no verdict and no board product, so it is NOT counted as a run. The authorised run then produced the board and crashed only at the JSON emission (--json-out bug, fixed in the same commit); the C1-C9 verdict was re-derived READ-ONLY from the produced board + the product's own final DRC, so the chain was still run exactly once.

element_3_corrected_plan.the_interface_question: A-prime's criterion set (in particular C6 = 'no copper outside the frozen frame may change') and the product's method ('re-route the affected nets') are not currently compatible. ONE of the two must be corrected - and ONLY the supervisor may choose (a criterion is judgement semantics).

option_A_restrict_the_product_work_scope.what: bound the product's ROUTER SEARCH to the frozen frame (a new bound parameter - the existing `--radius`/`--margin` are the damage radius and the search window around a gap, not a hard block bound), so new copper cannot leave the frame
option_A_restrict_the_product_work_scope.cost: touches the in-register product tools/k2_reroute_affected_v2.py => needs the supervisor's licence; may raise C1 (a gap that could only be closed by leaving the frame would become unroutable)
option_A_restrict_the_product_work_scope.verdict_from_evidence: unknown until run - do NOT guess

option_B_restate_C6_for_the_product_path.what: keep C6 only for the BLOCK chain and define the product path's fidelity criterion as 'the 16 PCIE_DN* nets untouched + the frames-outside copper may change ONLY where an affected net is re-routed' (i.e. C6 becomes 'no UNRELATED net's outside copper changes')
option_B_restate_C6_for_the_product_path.cost: weakens an approved criterion (#K2-372 sec.2.3) => supervisor only
option_B_restate_C6_for_the_product_path.verdict_from_evidence: the 250 delta is confined to AFFECTED nets (I2C1_SDA/PERSTA#/MCU_VDD/I2C2_SDA/PWR_BTN_OUT) - i.e. it is explainable as 'affected-net work', not as collateral damage

element_3_corrected_plan.recommendation: prefer option A as the ENGINE's default (the block boundary is the whole point of the BLOCK model), and offer option B only if the supervisor judges that A-prime's C6 must be scoped to unaffected nets. Either way the next A-prime attempt must be a NEW authorised window (this one's N=1 is spent).
element_3_corrected_plan.residual_c1: C1=14 must be closed by the SAME decision's implementation (the product's own acceptance line requires unconnected == 0), otherwise the next run fails again.

element_4_buildability.meaning: the placement is legal and witnessed; the copper build is proven feasible (the product path got within 14 unconnected and 4 new DRC classes) but its scope must be reconciled with C6 first.
